qualifications: The run failed in Ihfr after the full E2E suite passed. Complete frontend matrices cannot turn this into an overall successful run.
No IHFR screenshot or error-context file was uploaded; absence of those files limits visual diagnosis of the HTTP404 failure.
These pixels precede the later helper changes. The inherited screenshot-disabled/readiness-order limitations remain applicable even though the Codex review on this phase 7 SHA reported no findings.
Pink screenshot masks cross navigation in the narrow draft views and parts of the header in other views. They do not prove real field overlap or fully unobstructed navigation pixels.

Some narrow environmental form and last-field frames visibly have the header outside the viewport and navigation displaced above blank space; the metadata document scroll is preserved, not normalized away.
The landscape final Declivity input is whole but its label is partly above the sticky header boundary.
The development indicator overlaps part of the first mobile navigation label in some frames.

The invalid-expanded flow shows the focused required field and inline error. The review flow distinguishes No from Not informed. The confirmed flow shows the top context only, so the screenshot alone does not show the complete confirmed dataset.
Visible zero and No states do not prove all false/zero/null/absent/partial or precision round trips. Those contracts depend on the separately recorded assertions and HTTP results.
Physical-device keyboard, assistive technology and manual accessibility acceptance are not established by these emulated static captures.
